turns.replyText:
I understand that when giving a gift, you want to make sure the recipient has options if it is not quite the right fit!

We offer a 30-day window from the date of delivery for returns or exchanges. To be eligible, the item must be in new and sellable condition, meaning it is free of visible damage, stains, or pet hair. Please keep in mind that rug swatches are final sale and we allow for one exchange per item. Tumble covers the shipping costs for the return, so it will cost your recipient nothing to send it back.

To start an exchange, the recipient would just need to visit our Returns/Exchange Center:

Tumble US: https://www.tumbleliving.com/pages/returns-and-exchanges
Tumble Canada: https://www.tumbleliving.ca/pages/returns-and-exchanges

They will need the order number and the email address used to place the order. Once the form is submitted, a prepaid FedEx return label will be emailed to them. They can print this at home or take the return details to a FedEx Office Print & Ship Center to have the label printed for them.

If they decide to exchange for the same size, they should indicate that in the portal. Our team will then confirm if the replacement will ship as a rug cover only or a full set.

Regarding your previous question about gift receipts and messages, I am still looking into the best way to help with that. Could you please share your email address so I can have a specialist follow up with you?

Thank you for being a Tumble customer! Please let me know if you have any other questions. 🙂
